column1: # GameAction type id -> the tooltip TOKEN(s) its branch of FUN_0149e450 looks LDB category 170 up by (#782).
# Composed from two dumps, neither of which says this on its own:
#   1. tools/ghidra/DumpSwitchTable.java over the builder's dense switch
#      (BYTES=14a2e90 COUNT=f9 TARGETS=14a2de8 BASE=cf0a) - type id -> branch address;
#   2. docs/re/gameaction-tooltip-tokens.tsv - token -> the call site that pushes it.
